description: Benchmark evaluation dataset for BMS/DSPF to React 19 TypeScript Semantic AI Validation using Mutation Testing. Contains clean controls and injected functional defects.
creationMethodology: Mutation Testing: Clean controls extracted from real CICS BMS maps (e.g. CardDemo COCRDUP, BNK1ACC). Systematically injected with 8 realistic mutations covering all categories of the taxonomy.
limitations: Ground truth represents standard 3270 Model 2 to React conversions.
Tolerance allows minor comment or whitespace variations.

cases.title: Clean Control: COCRDUP Credit Card Update
cases.description: Synthetic clean control: COCRDUP.bms converted faithfully into React 19 TSX. Zero semantic discrepancies.

sourceFiles.content:
COCRDUP  DFHMSD TYPE=&SYSPARM,MODE=INOUT,LANG=COBOL,STORAGE=AUTO,      X
               TIOAPFX=YES,TERM=3270-2
CCRDUPA  DFHMDI SIZE=(24,80),LINE=1,COLUMN=1
         DFHMDF POS=(1,1),LENGTH=5,ATTRB=(ASKIP,NORM),INITIAL='Tran:'
TRNNAME  DFHMDF POS=(1,7),LENGTH=4,ATTRB=(ASKIP,NORM)
         DFHMDF POS=(8,23),LENGTH=19,ATTRB=(ASKIP,NORM),              X
               INITIAL='Card Number       :'
CARDSID  DFHMDF POS=(8,45),LENGTH=16,ATTRB=(UNPROT,NORM)
         DFHMDF POS=(24,1),LENGTH=21,ATTRB=(ASKIP,NORM),              X
               INITIAL='ENTER=Process F3=Exit'
         DFHMSD TYPE=FINAL

cases.title: Clean Control: BNK1ACC Bank Account Details
cases.description: Synthetic clean control: Account details with numeric account number and password.

sourceFiles.content:
BNK1ACC  DFHMDI SIZE=(24,80)
         DFHMDF POS=(5,10),LENGTH=12,INITIAL='Account No:'
ACCTNO   DFHMDF POS=(5,25),LENGTH=10,ATTRB=(UNPROT,NUM)
         DFHMDF POS=(7,10),LENGTH=9,INITIAL='Password:'
PASSWD   DFHMDF POS=(7,25),LENGTH=8,ATTRB=(UNPROT,DRK)
         DFHMDF POS=(24,1),LENGTH=15,INITIAL='ENTER=Submit'

cases.title: Mutation 1: Missing Input Field CARDSID
cases.description: Mutated: The input element for CARDSID was dropped during React generation.

expectedFindings.description: Field CARDSID is declared in BMS but missing in React JSX.

cases.title: Mutation 2: Length Mismatch on Card Number
cases.description: Mutated: BMS defines LENGTH=16, but React component has maxLength={10}.

targetFiles.content: <input style={{ gridRow: 8, gridColumn: '45 / span 16' }} id="cardsid" maxLength={10} />

expectedFindings.description: BMS declared LENGTH=16, but React maxLength is 10.

cases.title: Mutation 3: Secret Password Rendered as Plain Text
cases.description: Mutated: BMS declares ATTRB=DRK (password), but React uses type='text'.

targetFiles.content: <input style={{ gridRow: 7, gridColumn: '25 / span 8' }} id="passwd" type="text" maxLength={8} />

expectedFindings.description: BMS field PASSWD has ATTRB=DRK, but React input has type='text' instead of type='password'.

cases.title: Mutation 4: Layout Grid Row Divergence
cases.description: Mutated: BMS defines POS=(8,45), but React gridRow is placed at row 15.

targetFiles.content: <input style={{ gridRow: 15, gridColumn: '45 / span 16' }} id="cardsid" maxLength={16} />

expectedFindings.description: BMS declared position row 8, but React component is placed at gridRow 15.

cases.title: Mutation 5: Dropped Function Key F3 Listener
cases.description: Mutated: BMS screen defines 'ENTER=Process F3=Exit', but React only listens for Enter.

expectedFindings.description: BMS defines F3=Exit, but React component lacks F3 key handler in FUNCTION_KEYS.

cases.title: Mutation 6: Missing NUM Numeric Attribute
cases.description: Mutated: BMS declares ATTRB=NUM, but React input does not specify numeric mode.

targetFiles.content: <input style={{ gridRow: 5, gridColumn: '25 / span 10' }} id="acctno" maxLength={10} />

expectedFindings.description: BMS field ACCTNO has ATTRB=NUM, but React input lacks inputMode='numeric'.

cases.title: Mutation 7: Corrupted Initial Date Format
cases.description: Mutated: BMS specifies initial 'mm/dd/yy', but React initializes with 'dd-mm-yyyy'.

expectedFindings.description: BMS INITIAL was 'mm/dd/yy', but React code initializes with 'dd-mm-yyyy'.

cases.title: Mutation 8: Dropped Customer Name Field CRDNAME
cases.description: Mutated: The CRDNAME field declared in BMS was not generated in React.

targetFiles.content: {'Name on card :'}

expectedFindings.description: Field CRDNAME is declared in BMS but missing in React JSX.
